decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Location plan: L/01 Rev "0", Existing plan: L/02 Rev "0", Proposed Site plan: L/03 REV "0", Section plan: L/32 Rev "5", Roof plan: L/13 Rev "4", Elevations: L/21 Rev "4", Received: 31/07/2015 and 
Floor plan: L/12 Rev "3" Received: 01/09/2015) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a front roof extension to the house
